mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_history (thread_id, role, content, source_doc, heading_path, create_time) VALUES (#{threadId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sourceDoc}, #{headingPath}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (thread_id) * FROM chat_history ORDER BY thread_id, create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_history SET rating = #{rating} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(content) AS query, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM chat_history WHERE role = 'user' GROUP BY TRIM(content) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY cnt DESC
